description: Adapted from docling (MIT) via the xberg test-document corpus (td/vendored/docling): a heading nested in an unclosed paragraph and tables in divs keep their text. Input html/files/html_heading_in_p.html (see ../README.txt). Tika 4.2.0 (oracle, /tika/text) does not write the title into the body text (it is metadata dc:title), so that is what is asserted.
